_comment: Pack recipe for the 0 A.D. CREATURE rigs. Read by tools/rigpack, which writes
one directory per family BESIDE this file, named for the exporter's own slug:
./build/badlands_rigpack --recipe assets/characters/0ad/pack.json \
--intermediate /tmp/animexport
./build/badlands_viewer --rig assets/characters/0ad/wolf/rig.json
The intermediate is not in this repo -- regenerate it from the 0ad checkout,
branch export/badlands-anim. See tools/rigpack/README.md.
Source art is CC-BY-SA 3.0 (0 A.D., art/LICENSE.txt). Each packed clip records
the .dae it came from, which is what carries that attribution forward.
"clips": "*" takes every clip of every family listed -- 940 in all -- because
the point of these rigs is to be browsed. Consequence: they carry 0 A.D.'s own
clip names, so none has a clip called "idle". Nothing points the game here
(it uses assets/characters/quaternius); doing so would need a name mapping.
WHY THESE 31 AND NOT ALL 68: the excluded families are gates, ships, sails,
chariots, siege artillery, banners and markers -- 280 clips, and only ~9 MB, so
this list is about relevance rather than size. Add a family here and repack if
one turns out to matter.
CLASSIFIED BY SOURCE PATH, NOT BY NAME. Seven of these are creatures whose
family name does not say so, and the exporter warns that 28 of 68 families are
named after a fallback root bone:
main_pelvis-node = giraffe    Head_Rotation_IK = camel   Main = shark
Horse-node       = lion       Deer01_Pelvis    = rabbit  Body = crow
fish_shoal_armature = birds
The reverse trap: Aspron_Armature is 36 clips of a SHIELD prop, not an animal,
and is deliberately absent.
_yaw_note: 0 for every imported 0 A.D. rig. The exporter's Z-up -> Y-up rotation already
lands them facing +Z (kCharacterForward), so no per-rig fudge is needed. This
is unlike the Quaternius rig, which faces -Z and keeps its 180 offset.
